config/db.toml.text:
# Database settings
[database]
url = "postgres://db.example.com:5432/orders"
pool_size = 10
timeout_seconds = 60

[database.replica]
url = "postgres://replica.example.com:5432/orders"
enabled = false

reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('config/db.toml')
t = p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
old = 'timeout_seconds = 30'
assert t.count(old) == 1
p.write_bytes(t.replace(old, 'timeout_seconds = 60').encode('utf-8'))
EOF
